checks.root_repair: The original least-residue construction allowed the full selector to be zero. The canonical theorem uses the nonzero shifted representative Ztilde=Z+P_M, preserving every residue, giving P_M<=Ztilde<2P_M and the same exact radical. Certificate, report, ledger, and manifest were regenerated or updated accordingly.

mathematical_audit.selector: CRT gives one residue Z modulo the squarefree product P_M. Adding P_M produces a nonzero representative with exactly the same residues at every candidate prime, including the full-zero pattern Ztilde=P_M and empty pattern Ztilde=P_M+1.
mathematical_audit.radical: For p dividing P_M, p divides Ztilde exactly when p lies in the prescribed subset. Squarefreeness therefore gives gcd(P_M,Ztilde,Ztilde) equal to the subset product.
mathematical_audit.geometry: The direct sum of two Item374 rank-two filtered modules has rank four, fixed Hodge data, and joint Hasse divisor q1=q2=0. Item383's lambda=2 lift supplies flat rational logarithmic connections with fixed poles at qi=1/2; selector values 0 and 1 avoid them.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The candidate interval has Chebyshev mass M/6+o(M). The full nonzero selector realizes all candidates while having logarithmic height log(P_M)+O(1), proving sharp full raw capacity for the stated information class.
mathematical_audit.scope_limit: This is a comparison-family no-go. It supplies no restriction on the actual moving moment selector and proves no bound on W_(H,T)(M).
